articles.summary: TIME and Newsweek name Covista among top-ranked companies as it trains the next generation of nurses, physicians and healthcare workers Covista (NYSE: CVSA), formerly Adtalem Global Education, America’s largest healthcare educator, today announced it has been recognized in four rankings awarded by TIME and Newsweek. The honors weigh growth, financial stability, workplace culture and sustainability performance. They come as Covista works to address the healthcare workforce shortage by training the next generation of healthcare professionals at an industry-leading scale. Honors Include: TIME’s America’s Growth Leaders 2027 Covista ranked 46 out of 500 companies on TIME’s America’s Growth Leaders . The ranking honors companies that demonstrate exceptional growth performance, financial stability and stock performance. articles.title: Covista Recognized by TIME and Newsweek for Growth, Workplace Culture and Sustainability

articles.summary: New analysis finds that students at Ross University School of Medicine (RUSM) and American University of the Caribbean School of Medicine (AUC) pass USMLE Step 1 on their first attempt at rates comparable to—and in most MCAT score bands higher than—U.S. MD students with similar MCAT scores. Newly analyzed data from Covista (NYSE: CVSA) institutions Ross University School of Medicine (RUSM) and American University of the Caribbean School of Medicine (AUC) shows that students’ MCAT scores alone do not determine their likelihood of success in medical school. Strong academic support, student services and outcomes-focused curricula can help students achieve success across MCAT score ranges. Analysis of internal and third-party data from the Association of American Medical Colleges (AAMC) found that students at RUSM and AUC passed the United States Medical Licensing Examination® (USMLE®) Step 1 on their first attempt at rates equal to or higher than U.S. MD students who entered medical
articles.title: Students at Covista Medical Schools Match or Exceed U.S. MD Peers on USMLE Step 1 First-Time Pass Rates Across MCAT Ranges
